## LibreLinkUp Rust Desktop v0.4.1

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Fix Regional API Endpoint Selection (`api-eu.libreview.io`)**:
  - Fixed a bug where non-redirect authentication responses (`data.redirect == false`) overwrote the user's selected login region (e.g., `eu`) with the account profile's ISO country code (`data.user.country`, such as `FI`), causing subsequent CGM requests to target non-existent country-specific subdomains (`https://api-fi.libreview.io/llu/connections`).
  - Added official LibreView ISO-3166 country-to-region normalization (`normalize_country_code`) across all Abbott LibreView regional clusters (`us`, `global`, `eu`, `eu2`, `de`, `fr`, `ca`, `au`, `ap`, `jp`, `ae`, `la`), mapping European/EEA/EMEA country codes (`FI`, `SE`, `NO`, `DK`, `NL`, `BE`, `AT`, `ES`, `IT`, `PL`, `PT`, `CH`, `ZA`, etc.) to `eu`, `GB`/`UK`/`IE` to `eu2`, `NZ` to `au`, and Asia-Pacific/Latin American country codes to `ap`/`la`.
  - **Automatic Vault Self-Healing**: Existing encrypted credential vaults (`%APPDATA%\LibreLinkUpDesktop\credentials.enc.json` on Windows and `~/.local/share/librelinkup-kde/credentials.enc.json` on Linux) that stored a raw country code (such as `fi`) in `v0.4.0` are automatically normalized and healed on startup without requiring re-login.
  - Added a **Regional Endpoint** selector to the **Settings** view on both Windows and Linux KDE Plasma 6, and added `la` (`Latin America`) to the region list.

### Linux Flatpak Installation (`x86_64`)

```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/russellmilliner/librelinkup-rust-desktop/releases/download/v0.4.1/librelinkup-rust-desktop-v0.4.1-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak install --user -y librelinkup-rust-desktop-v0.4.1-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak run io.github.russellmilliner.LibreLinkUpDesktop
```
